entries.1d42346b4c6f818d: Sells food processing raw materials such as marine products, agricultural products, and livestock products, and also transports them. Its role is that of a specialized trading company that delivers raw materials to food manufacturers and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥117,421 million.
entries.3ad6ce8dcc17b730: Recovers and smelts scrap containing precious metals generated from the manufacture of electronic components and semiconductors, and sells it as bullion such as gold, silver, platinum, and palladium, as chemical products, and as electronic materials. It also collects, transports, and processes industrial waste. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥570,422 million.
